title: The people behind the work.
lead: The assignments on this page were led or supported by IP3’s founder for development banks, governments, bilateral donors, foundations and firms. IP3’s network of economists, policy specialists and sector experts joins as each brief requires.
founderSummary: Economist and costing and financing specialist: program costing, economic and financial analysis, feasibility assessment, financial modelling, financing strategy, sensitivity analysis, M&E and scale-up planning for World Bank, ADB, IFC, government and other development-partner programs.
founderEducation: MSc in Economics, University of Surrey; MSS and BSS in Economics, University of Dhaka.
